title: The Midnight Library
intro:
You wake up with your cheek on a cold wooden floor. A single green-shaded lamp lights a private library you have never seen before. Somewhere behind you a lock clicks shut.

Around you are a **desk** with a drawer, a tall **bookshelf**, a large **painting**, a glass **cabinet**, a silent **grandfather clock** and a heavy oak **door** with a keypad.

What do you do?
room_description: You are in a private library lit by one green-shaded lamp. There is a desk with a drawer, a tall bookshelf, a large painting, a glass cabinet, a grandfather clock and a heavy oak door with a keypad.

desk.name: desk
desk.examine: An old oak desk with a green-shaded lamp. A handwritten note is pinned under the lamp: "Knowledge has colours. Read red first, then green, then blue." Below the desktop is a single drawer.

drawer.name: drawer
drawer.examine_locked: The desk drawer is held shut by a three-digit combination lock.
drawer.unlock_text: The combination lock clicks and the drawer slides open.

bookshelf.name: bookshelf
bookshelf.examine: Hundreds of dusty brown books fill the shelves. Three books look new and stick out from the rest: a blue book marked "Vol. {book_blue}", a red book marked "Vol. {book_red}" and a green book marked "Vol. {book_green}".

painting.name: painting
painting.examine: A large oil painting of a night sky over a lighthouse. In normal light there is nothing unusual about it.
painting.examine_revealed: The painting of the lighthouse. Under the violet light four glowing digits are visible in the corner: {door_code}.
painting.reveal_text: The violet beam sweeps across the canvas and four glowing digits appear in the corner of the painting: {door_code}.

cabinet.name: glass cabinet
cabinet.examine_locked: A glass-fronted cabinet secured with a small brass lock. Through the glass you can see a strange torch with a violet lens, but you cannot reach it.
cabinet.unlock_text: The brass key turns in the lock and the glass door of the cabinet swings open.

clock.name: grandfather clock
clock.examine: A tall grandfather clock, stopped at midnight. Words are engraved on the still pendulum: "What the eye cannot see, violet light will free."

door.name: door
door.examine_locked: A heavy oak door, firmly locked. Next to it is an electronic keypad waiting for a four-digit code.
door.unlock_text: The keypad turns green, the bolts slide back and the heavy oak door swings open. Cool night air rushes in. You have escaped the Midnight Library!

brass_key.name: brass key
brass_key.description: A small brass key. It looks like it fits a small lock.

uv_flashlight.name: UV flashlight
uv_flashlight.description: A torch with a violet lens. It gives off ultraviolet light.

hints.drawer_code: The note on the desk talks about colours. Have a close look at the bookshelf.
hints.take_brass_key: The drawer is open. Have you taken what is inside?
hints.cabinet_key: You are carrying a key. Something in this room has a small brass lock.
hints.take_uv_flashlight: The cabinet is open. Have you taken what is inside?
hints.painting_uv: The clock's pendulum says violet light reveals what the eye cannot see. What in this room is meant to be looked at?
hints.door_code: You have seen four glowing digits. The door keypad is waiting for a four-digit code.
